sentences.text: Kayleigh Brennan (Tenant) and Moira Quinn (Support worker, Brightwater Advice Project) were present for the housing needs assessment.
Kayleigh Brennan (Tenant) lives alone with her children, Alfie (7 years old) and Mia (3 years old).
Kayleigh Brennan (Tenant) lives at Flat 4, 18 Cobden Street, a two-bedroom flat on the top floor.
Kayleigh Brennan (Tenant) has lived at the property since the summer of 2021.
The tenancy is held privately through Kerridge and Lowe agents with Mr Haskins as the landlord.
Kayleigh Brennan (Tenant) was the sole tenant on the tenancy; her ex-partner Liam moved in after her and is no longer living there.
Liam moved out on August 9th (the day after Alfie's birthday).
S1 advised S2 not to rely on the claim that the council would rehouse her immediately if she were evicted, stating 'That's not how it works'.
S1 offered to refer the tenant's issues regarding damp, mould, and a socket to the private sector housing team and environmental health.
S2 asked if the housing team would know she was the one complaining about the repairs.
S1 stated that the housing team would contact the tenant but that they cannot evict the tenant for complaining about repairs.
S2 asked when the housing team would come out to inspect the property.
S1 stated he could not give a specific date for the visit but would send a referral by the end of the week.
S2 reported that Mrs Patel downstairs stated the council came out to her flat last year regarding damp.
S1 stated he could not see the building record in the system at that time.
Kayleigh Brennan (Tenant) reports damp in the children's bedroom around the window and behind Alfie's bed, and a black ceiling in the bathroom.
Kayleigh Brennan (Tenant) states the damp has been present since last winter and has worsened in the current winter.
Kayleigh Brennan (Tenant) reports the agent has told her the damp is condensation caused by her drying washing in the flat.
Kayleigh Brennan (Tenant) states the landlord and agent have never inspected the damp issue.
Kayleigh Brennan (Tenant) reports a plug socket near Alfie's bed sparked last week and is now brown.
Kayleigh Brennan (Tenant) states Alfie has asthma and was admitted to A&E on October 14th.
Kayleigh Brennan (Tenant) states Alfie may be autistic and is on the waiting list for an assessment.
Kayleigh Brennan (Tenant) denies any violence or abuse in her relationship with Liam.
Kayleigh Brennan (Tenant) states Liam is currently in Bristol.
S3 suggested S2 consider a disrepair claim for compensation, noting the impact of a year of poor housing on a child with asthma.
S2 expressed a wish not to sue, stating 'I don't want to sue him. I just want it fixed. I'll lose the flat.'
S3 clarified that a disrepair claim is not exactly 'suing'.
S2 denied wanting to proceed with a claim at that time, stating 'No. Not now. Please.'
S1 recorded that Moira raised the option of a claim and that S2 did not want to go ahead with it.
S1 asked S2 if there was anyone she could stay with if things went badly.
S2 disclosed that her mum might be an option, living in Hull in a one-bed flat, but S2 had not asked her yet.
S1 stated that S2's mum being an option was fine but it was not a formal plan.
The current rent is £895 per month (increased from £850 in April).
Universal Credit covers £725 per month for housing.
Kayleigh Brennan (Tenant) is short £170 per month in housing costs.
Kayleigh Brennan (Tenant) works 12 hours a week in the kitchen at Cobden Road Primary School.
Kayleigh Brennan (Tenant) earns approximately £630 per month from her work.
Kayleigh Brennan (Tenant) has no child maintenance payments from Liam.
Kayleigh Brennan (Tenant) has no savings.
Kayleigh Brennan (Tenant) is owed approximately £2,400 in arrears, though the agent's letter dated November 2nd states £1,960.
Kayleigh Brennan (Tenant) states the arrears accumulated because the joint claim closed when Liam left, resulting in a new claim that took five weeks, causing no housing money for
Kayleigh Brennan (Tenant) has never been in arrears before this incident.
Kayleigh Brennan (Tenant) has never been evicted.
Kayleigh Brennan (Tenant) received a text from Mr Haskins on November 17th threatening legal action if arrears were not sorted by the end of the month.
Kayleigh Brennan (Tenant) has not received any formal notice or solicitor's letter in the post.
The Housing Options Officer (Marcus Fenn) is opening a prevention case to help keep Kayleigh Brennan (Tenant) in the flat.
S1 requested S3 to obtain a GP letter regarding Alfie's asthma and the damp from Millfield Surgery.
S3 stated she would need until the fourth of December to obtain the GP letter, noting the surgery is slow.
S1 confirmed a prevention case was opened on the day of the call.
S1 stated statements from the tenant would be required by Thursday.
S1 stated the tenant's statement would be submitted by the Housing Officer (DHP) on Friday the twenty-seventh.
S1 stated he would ring the agent about the fifty a month rent issue this week.
S1 stated the referral to the private sector housing team would be sent by the end of the week.
S1 stated the GP letter would be obtained by the fourth of December.
S1 scheduled a follow-up meeting for Tuesday the eighth at ten o'clock.
S1 confirmed he was not available on Mondays.
S1 instructed S2 to send any court or notice letters to Moira the same day they are received.
S1 instructed S2 to forward any court or notice letters directly to him after sending them to Moira.
